WebRTC AudioProcessing Windows Vendored Profile
==============================================

This directory is intended to hold a vendored WebRTC AudioProcessing SDK used
by `speech_utils` Windows native recorder bindings.

The hook expects this SDK under:
- `third_party/webrtc_apm/windows`

Current vendored source archive:
- `https://github.com/balacoon/webrtc_audio_processing/releases/download/1.3/win_webrtc.tar.gz`

Required artifacts:
- `include/webrtc-audio-processing-1/modules/audio_processing/include/audio_processing.h`
  (or `include/modules/audio_processing/include/audio_processing.h`)
- `lib/webrtc-audio-processing-1.lib`
  (or `webrtc_audio_processing*.lib` / `audio_processing*.lib`)

Optional runtime artifact (if linking against a DLL import library):
- `bin/webrtc-audio-processing-*.dll`
- `bin/webrtc-audio-coding-*.dll` (dependency runtime)
